module: Garage "computer" menu in career mode. openMenu builds the list of vehicles in the nearest garage, lets other modules add their buttons via the onComputerAddFunctions hook, starts a tether (the menu closes if the player moves away), then navigates to the 'career.computer' UI screen. A modder adds a button by implementing onComputerAddFunctions(menuData, computerFunctions) in their extension.
usage:
-- add a general button to the computer menu
M.onComputerAddFunctions = function(menuData, computerFunctions)
  computerFunctions.general.monBouton = {
    id = 'monBouton', label = 'Mon bouton', callback = function(computerId) print(computerId) end,
    disabled = false
  }
end
notes: computerFunctions has two sub-tables: general[buttonId] and vehicleSpecific[inventoryId][buttonId]; each entry has a callback(computerId).
M.reasons contains ready-made reasons (tutorialActive, hasBoughtStarterVehicle, needsRepair); getComputerUIData translates their label via core_locales.

Probable bug: in openMenu, the startSphereTether(computerPos, ...) fallback uses the variable computerPos, which is not defined (the line that computes it is commented out); it is nil if the facility has no door.
Tether distances: 1 m (box, door) and 4 m (sphere).

reasons.desc: Standard reasons for disabling a button: tutorialActive, hasBoughtStarterVehicle (type 'text') and needsRepair (type 'needsRepair'), each with a translation label.

openMenu.desc: Opens the computer menu for a facility: lists the vehicles in the nearest garage (name, repair need, dirt date), fires onComputerAddFunctions, starts the tether, navigates to 'career.computer', then fires onComputerMenuOpened.

resetActiveVehicleIndex.desc: Passed to the UI in menuData.resetActiveVehicleIndex.

openComputerMenuById.desc: Gets the 'computer' facility by its id via freeroam_facilities.getFacility, then calls openMenu.

computerButtonCallback.desc: Called by the UI on a click: finds the button (vehicleSpecific[inventoryId] if inventoryId is given, otherwise general) and runs its callback(computerId).

inventoryId.desc: Inventory id of the vehicle for a vehicle-specific button.

getComputerUIData.desc: Returns to the UI a copy of the menu data: computerFunctions (reason labels translated, inventoryId keys converted to strings), vehicles (with thumbnail and inventoryId as a string), facilityName, resetActiveVehicleIndex, computerId. Empty table if the menu has not been opened.

onMenuClosed.desc: Hook called when the menu closes; removes the tether (tether.remove = true).

closeMenu.desc: Closes all career menus (career_career.closeAllMenus). Also serves as the tether callback when the player moves away.
